The Bengals, led by quarterback Joe Burrow, have revamped their defense with key offseason additions, including defensive tackle Dexter Lawrence. The Buccaneers, led by quarterback Baker Mayfield, have also made significant changes, with a new offensive coordinator in Zac Robinson. The game will likely be decided by the Bengals' ability to prevent big plays and the Buccaneers' ability to create explosive plays.

2026_01_WAS_PHI.headline: Washington’s rebound attempt runs directly into Philadelphia’s physical core
2026_01_WAS_PHI.paragraph1: Philadelphia opens its title defense with Jalen Hurts leading an offense that has changed coordinators again but retained its physical identity. Washington is trying to rebound after a five-win season and needs Jayden Daniels healthy enough to restore the creation ability that powered his rookie breakout. The Eagles will be without edge rusher Jonathan Greenard, giving Washington some relief in protection, but Philadelphia can still create pressure with its remaining rotation. Early-down rushing efficiency, protection around Daniels and Hurts’ ability to punish broken contain should drive the divisional matchup.
